title: Bella Vita | KEY.co
description_expanded: The cottage’s second floor is where memories are made, featuring a spacious open-concept area that combines the living, dining, and kitchen into one seamless space for family gatherings. The master suite is a sanctuary of its own with a plush king-sized bed, a luxurious ensuite that includes a jetted soaking tub and a walk-in rain shower, and access to a private balcony with mesmerizing Gulf views. Additional balconies flank the living area, offering spots to observe the vibrant Seaside community or serene water vistas. The jewel in the crown is the viewing deck, accessible via a spiral staircase, where panoramic views of the Gulf set the stage for spectacular dolphin sightings and unforgettable sunset evenings. This residence isn’t just a place to stay—it’s a gateway to a sublime coastal lifestyle, where every detail enhances the joy of seaside living. Tucked away just steps from the Seaside town center, this beachside cottage offers an exclusive retreat for families and friends. With its charming façade and strategic location, the residence boasts four bedrooms, four-and-a-half bathrooms, and multiple living spaces across two levels, each thoughtfully designed for comfort and convenience. The airy interiors are flooded with natural light, highlighting the cottage’s fine finishes and elegant decor. Whether you're lounging in the secondary living area on the first floor, enjoying movies, or stepping out to the back porch for easy beach access, relaxation is just a part of the everyday experience here. The layout also features three beautifully appointed guest bedrooms on the ground floor, ensuring privacy and comfort for all guests.
